models_evaluated: external OHCA neurological outcome prediction model trained on large PAROS cohort

links.outcome: Model AUROC for neurological outcome on local cohort before vs after transfer learning
links.effect: Vietnam: external model AUROC 0.467 (95% CI 0.141-0.785) vs transfer learning 0.807 (0.626-0.948). Singapore: 0.945 vs 0.955.
links.quote: The external model performed poorly on the Vietnam cohort, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.467 (95% CI: 0.141-0.785), but TL markedly improved performance (AUROC = 0.807, 95% CI: 0.626-0.948).

links.outcome: External model performance on a new-setting cohort versus development setting
links.effect: External model AUROC 0.467 (95% CI 0.141-0.785) on the Vietnam cohort, i.e. poor generalization.
links.quote: The external model performed poorly on the Vietnam cohort, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.467 (95% CI: 0.141-0.785), but TL markedly improved performance (AUROC = 0.807, 95% CI: 0.626-0.948).
